name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Key Account Marketing & Campaign Strategy
summary: B2B marketing and account management professional with 15+ years across agency, MarTech, and SaaS, building account-specific marketing plans and multichannel campaigns that drive client retention and revenue. At Level Agency, led integrated campaigns for multi-stakeholder accounts, advised on ad-spend budgets, and delivered QBRs tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner reseller network at Birdeye. Uses Salesforce, HubSpot, GA4, Power BI, and AI tools to turn large data sets into clear performance narratives and next steps.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary marketing relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, building account-specific plans from discovery into goals, market challenges, and revenue objectives.
Run multichannel programs across local SEO, Google Ads, email and SMS, landing pages, and LinkedIn, aligning messaging with business owners and sales teams.
Build performance dashboards in Power BI and GA4 tracking lead generation, funnel progression, and campaign ROI, and present insight-driven recaps with recommendations.
Use AI tools and LLM workflows daily to synthesize data and build personalized outreach, including an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses.
Grow accounts by scoping complementary services through proposals and SOWs.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated B2B marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content for multi-stakeholder accounts, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Advised clients on ad-spend budget planning and allocation across paid campaigns.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering QBRs and optimization recommendations.
Designed account-based LinkedIn campaigns targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups.
Represented Level Agency at industry events.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Equipped partners to communicate product value to their own customers, and analyzed utilization data to recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Represented Birdeye at tradeshows and events, and managed the partner book in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, analyzing paid media and creative performance and translating results into optimization recommendations.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ total).

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery.
Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while launching 25+ clients per month.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built relationships with C-suite executives at agencies and professional-services firms as a trusted advisor, and represented Accelo at tradeshows and events.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
